Class_Skill_Desc_Dance: Grants Poised to Sword Dance, Tempted to Tango, Jitterbugged, or Willing to Waltz, allowing the execution of an action depending on the effect granted.</br>Phantom Sword Dance Effect: Delivers an attack with high potency</br>Tempting Tango Effect: Deals unaspected damage and freezes time</br>Jitterbug Effect: Deals unaspected damage, absorbing a portion of damage dealt as HP, and afflicts target with Paralysis</br>Mystery Waltz Effect: Deals unaspected damage, afflicts target with Blind, and restores MP
Class_Skill_Desc_Mesmerize: Afflicts target with Enamored, reducing damage dealt by 40%.</br>Duration: 4s</br>Additional Effect: Afflicts target with Mesmerized</br>Mesmerized Effect: Reduces damage dealt by 10% and increases damage taken by 5%</br>Duration: 100s</br>Effect cannot be stacked with Phantom Cannoneer's Silver Sickness.
Class_Skill_Desc_Quickstep: Increases evasion by 20%.</br>Duration: 90s</br>Additional Effect: Grants Quicker Step to self and nearby party members when executed within proximity of a knowledge crystal</br>Quicker Step Effect: Increases damage dealt by 2%</br>Duration: 30m
Class_Skill_Desc_Steadfast Stance: Grants Steadfast Stance.</br>When targeting a party member, rush to their side, granting both you and the target Steadfast Stance.</br>Steadfast Stance Effect: Grants a barrier that absorbs damage equal to 10% of maximum HP</br>Duration: 30s
